ideas.pitch: An offline-first satellite monitoring and computer vision tool to detect crop stress and yield anomalies tailored for regional farming conditions in Uttar Pradesh.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered predictive incident forecasting dashboard for urban water and power distribution networks using Poisson regression and spatial analytics.
ideas.title: GridSafe-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering and predictive modeling, mirroring the statistical rigor that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.title: MediTrust-Regional
